chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Muhammad ibn 'Umar ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn 'Uthafir, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He should fast the three days separately.
ai.seo_question: How should the three white days of fasting be observed according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) regarding the prohibition of fasting the three 'white days' (13th, 14th, and 15th) if they are observed separately. While some scholars interpret this as a restriction on *nafl* (voluntary) fasting to avoid resembling the Jewish practice of continuous fasting, others view it as a specific legal nuance within the broader permissibility of these days. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on distinguishing Islamic practices from preceding traditions while maintaining flexibility in voluntary worship.
